title: pvLANLFOFSODHaloFinder
body:
## pvLANLFOFSODHaloFinder

LANL cosmology halo finder (vtkPLANLHaloFinder): it groups particles into friends-of-friends halos using a linking length in units of the interparticle spacing and, if SphereOverdensityHalosSOD is on, also computes spherical-overdensity (SOD) halo mass and radius around each large FOF halo. The input must carry point arrays velocity, mass, tag and ghost, as produced by pvCosmoReader. Port 0 returns the particles with a HaloID array; port 1 one point per halo with HaloMass, AverageVelocity, VelocityDispersion and, with SOD, the SOD arrays.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- GenericIO particle data lack the required velocity, mass, tag and ghost arrays; use pvANLHaloFinder for those.
- Boxsize, Seedparticles and the mass thresholds must match the simulation; defaults are example values.
- MBP and MCP centre finding can be very slow.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `LANLFOFSODHaloFinder`. Identity: `filters/LANLHaloFinder`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input of the filter. Accepted data: unstructured grids (vtkUnstructuredGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkUnstructuredGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Boxsize` | The box side length used to wrap particles around if they exceed rL (or less than 0) in any dimension (only positive positions are allowed in the input, or they are wrapped around). | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `Centerfinder` | Method used for computing the halo center. WARNING: Using MBP or MCP can be very slow. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Average position","Center of mass","Most Bound Particle (MBP)","Most Connected Particle (MCP)"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Average position"` |
| `FOFmassthreshold` | Minimum FOF mass to calculate an SOD halo. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `FOFparticlethreshold` | Minimum number of particles (threshold) needed before a group is called a friends-of-friends (FOF) halo. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `FOFsizethreshold` | Minimum FOF halo size to calculate an SOD halo. | `{"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0` |
| `InitialSODmass` | The initial SOD mass. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `Linkinglength` | Linking length measured in units of interparticle spacing and is dimensionless. Used to link particles into halos for the friends-of-friends (FOF) algorithm. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `Maximumradiusfactor` | Maximum radius factor for SOD finding. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `Minimumradiusfactor` | Minimum radius factor for SOD finding. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `Numberofbins` | Number of bins for SOD finding. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Overlap` | The space (in rL units) to extend processor particle ownership for ghost particles/cells. Needed for correct halo calculation when halos cross processor boundaries in parallel computation. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `Seedparticles` | Number of seeded particles in one dimension. Therefore, total simulation particles is np^3 (cubed). | `{"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0` |
| `SphereOverdensityHalosSOD` | If checked, spherical overdensity (SOD) halos will be calculated in addition to friends-of-friends (FOF) halos. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `rho_c` | Specify the scale factor for rho_c (critical density) for SOD halo finding. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
